ASF_SeaTurtle.description: A large marine turtle with a sturdy shell.
ASF_BlueSpottedOctopus.description: A small but deadly octopus, its bright blue spots warn of a potent venom.
ASF_Marlin.description: A powerful fish that patrols the open ocean, prized by anglers for its challenge.
ASF_GardenSnail.description: A tiny snail that tumbles off the beach docks whenever a summer rainstorm rolls in.
ASF_RedRockCrab.description: A tough little crab that scuttles along sunny coastal rocks.
ASF_HermitCrab.description: A tiny crab that wanders the shore under the moonlight, always hiding in its shell when disturbed.
ASF_PinkHermitCrab.description: A small pink crab that scavenges along the shore.
ASF_OrangeStarfish.description: A bright orange starfish often seen clinging to rocks and tidepools.
ASF_Scallop.description: A common shellfish that rests in the sand, snapping its shell shut when disturbed.
ASF_AlaskanKingSalmon.description: A massive salmon known for the fierce fight it puts up for any angler.
ASF_Spooktopus.description: A rare and elusive octopus that emerges only on dark fall nights.
ASF_PinkJellyfish.description: A soft pink jellyfish that drifts near the shore on calm, warm nights.
ASF_BlueJellyfish.description: A glowing blue jellyfish that lights up dark waters as it floats along.
ASF_BrownEel.description: A slippery eel that emerges only during rain, twisting through murky waters in search of prey.
ASF_HammerheadShark.description: A large ocean predator easily identified by its wide, uniquely shaped head.
ASF_MahiMahi.description: A brightly colored ocean fish with striking golden scales.
ASF_LeopardStingray.description: A large stingray known for its distinctive dark spots.
ASF_RibbonEel.description: A brightly colored eel with long, ribbon-like fins.
ASF_GreenEel.description: A green eel that hides among seaweed, darting out to snatch passing prey.
ASF_OrangeEel.description: A rare orange eel that glows faintly in the dark, often spotted only after sunset.
ASF_Hookfin.description: A peculiar red fish that looks exactly like a pirate, complete with a tiny hat and eye patch.
ASF_PacificJellyfish.description: A large jellyfish with red tendrils that glow faintly in the dark.
ASF_FlameJellyfish.description: A rare jellyfish with an orange glow that illuminates the dark water.
ASF_Ghoulgill.description: A pale fish with translucent scales.
ASF_Broombell.description: A jellyfish with a pointed, hat-like bell that drifts gently through the deep waters.
ASF_JackOFish.description: A rare fish with bright orange patterns resembling a carved pumpkin.
ASF_Sprucefin.description: A festive fish with natural markings that resemble bright red ornaments and a gold star.
ASF_Jollyfin.description: A small fish known for its striking red and green stripes.
ASF_Pufferjelly.description: A tropical jellyfish that inflates itself when startled to deter predators.
ASF_AppleSnail.description: This snail is commonly found in warm, tropical waters.
ASF_TreeSpiderCrab.description: A purple crab that climbs mangrove roots during high tide, scavenging for insects and fruit.
ASF_Yellowtail.description: A sleek, fast-swimming fish with bright stripes along its body.
ASF_MossyEel.description: A slippery eel cloaked in a thick layer of algae and moss, only surfacing during strange rains.
ASF_HumpheadWrasse.description: A massive, hump-browed fish with vivid blue-green scales, roaming the coral reefs of Ginger Island.
ASF_Redpuff.description: A round pufferfish with shiny red scales. It is often mistaken for a holiday ornament.
ASF_Gingerfin.description: A warm brown fish with pale white markings that resemble icing.
ASF_Luckyfin.description: A fish wearing a familiar green hat that covers most of its body.
ASF_WhaleShark.description: A gentle giant of the sea.
ASF_Santafish.description: A winter fish with a distinct white beard-like growth around its mouth.
ASF_LemonShark.description: A coastal shark with pale yellow skin, often seen cruising through warm, shallow waters.
ASF_BlueDolphin.description: A dolphin often seen swimming alongside ships. Sailors have told stories about them for generations.
ASF_RubberDuck.description: Not exactly today's catch, but it seems happy to see you.
ASF_MermaidPearl.description: A rare pearl treasured by many anglers.
ASF_MermaidTear.description: A crystal gem said to have fallen from a mermaid's eye, it glows softly when held near the sea.
ASF_LunarPearl.description: A rare pearl said to absorb moonlight over the ocean.
ASF_RedCoral.description: A red coral that thrives in warm waters, it appears to be crunchy.
ASF_AncientShell.description: A fossilized shell, its surface etched with strange patterns worn smooth by time and tide.
ASF_PiratesDoubloon.description: A gold coin stamped with the face of a notorious pirate.
ASF_GrandpaToWillyLetter: Hello Willy!^^I still remember you from when we were younger, casting lines along the river together and swapping stories. You've always been a remarkable fisherman, and that morning catching all those salmon with you was one of the finest days I've had in years.^^I'm feeling weaker, and I believe the years have caught up with me, Willy. If you see my grandchild out on the farm someday, keep an eye on them for me, will you?^^- Grandpa^^[RETURNED TO SENDER]^^[#]Lost Letter From Grandpa
ASF_SpringWillyLetter: The winter chill is finally gone, @.^^Spring waters always bring the Sea Turtles back, and to my dismay, the Blue-Spotted Octopuses too. If you're aimin' for a Marlin, make sure your line is sturdy. They put up a fierce fight.^^See ye out there.^^- Willy[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_SummerWillyLetter: Sun's beatin' down hard lately, @.^^The Pink and Blue Jellyfish start floatin' up near the surface when the water gets this warm. If a storm blows in, keep your rod ready. That's usually when the Hammerhead Sharks come lookin' for a meal.^^Don't forget your hat.^^- Willy[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_SummerWillyRainLetter: Looks like the summer showers are bringin' folks out, @.^^Keep your eyes peeled for Garden Snails and Brown Eels. They're an easy catch on a rainy day, just watch your step on the docks.^^- Willy[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_FallWillyLetter: The winds are startin' to turn, @.^^Water's chillin' down, which means the Alaskan King Salmon are on the move. Just watch your hook at night. The Spooktopus likes the cold dark, and it's ruined more than one of my best lures.^^Good luck out there.^^- Willy[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WinterWillyLetter: Not many folks braving the cold these days, @.^^But underneath the ice, there's Sprucefin and Jollyfin swimmin' about. If you're patient, ye might even pull up a Gingerfin on a snowy day.^^Don't stay out too late, the sea breeze'll chill your bones.^^- Willy[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear1: Seems I got a bit busy this holiday season, @!^^Forgot to give you this little something!^^Better late than never, right?^^Enjoy!^^- Willy%item id 694 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear2: Would you believe it, forgot again, @!^^Guess old habits die hard.^^Here's a small token of my appreciation for your patience!^^- Willy%item id 727 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear3: Blast it all, I've gone and done it a third time, @!^^At this point it's tradition.^^Take this, friend.^^- Willy%item id 797 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear4: You know what, I just save a gift every year since I know I'll forget anyway, @!^^Take this one early.^^- Willy%item id 166 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear7: Seven years already, @!^^You've come a long way since your first rod!^^Here's a little something to help you haul in the big ones.^^- Willy%item id 856 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear10: Ten years, @!^^Feels like just yesterday you were learning to cast straight!^^Here's a rare treasure, for an even rarer friend.^^- Willy%item id GoldenMysteryBox 20%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear15: Fifteen years of castin' lines and sharin' tales, @.^^Time flows like the tide, and I'm right glad to have you anchored here in the valley.^^A loyal friend is the greatest catch of all.^^- Willy%item id 797 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear20: Twenty years, @... where has the time gone?^^My beard's gotten a bit grayer, but my spirits are higher than ever, knowin' I've got a true friend in the valley.^^Take this as a token of an old sailor's gratitude.^^- Willy%item id 166 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear25: A quarter of a century we've been fishin' these waters together, @.^^I've seen many folks come and go with the changing winds, but you... you're a permanent fixture, like the old lighthouse.^^Thank ye for everything.^^- Willy%item id 279 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear30: Thirty years, @. That's a lifetime for some.^^When my ol' Pappy left me this rod, I never imagined it'd lead to a friendship like ours. You've brought more joy to this old sailor's heart than the biggest catch of the season.^^Yoba bless ye, my dear friend.^^- Willy%item id StardropTea 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear40: Hello there, @. Took me a good ten minutes to figure out what year it was on the calendar today. You've been here forty years? That's a long time to be farmin' the valley. I found this tucked behind the counter. Pretty sure it was meant to be your Winter Star gift. Sorry it's a bit late.^^- Willy%item id 797 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear50: Ah, @. I was talkin' to Gus the other day and it made me realize we've been fishin' these waters together for half a century. I actually bought this for ye last week, but completely forgot to hand it over. My apologies.^^- Willy%item id 279 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear60: @, I'm writin' this down before I forget again. I keep meanin' to bring this over to your farm, but every time I start walkin' that way, I get distracted by the tide pools and end up back at my shop. Figured I'd just let the mail carrier handle it this time.^^- Willy%item id 166 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear70: I went to the Saloon yesterday and could've sworn I saw ye sittin' in the corner, @. Turns out it was just a coat rack with a hat on it. My head's gettin' a bit foggy these days, but I still remember I owe ye a gift. Here you go.^^- Willy%item id StardropTea 10%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear80: I had this great idea for a Christmas present for ye. Spent all morning wrappin' it up nice and neat. Then I put it down somewhere and for the life of me, I can't find it. So I just threw these in a box instead. Hope ye don't mind.^^- Willy%item id GoldenMysteryBox 30%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear90: Hello @. I am writing this on behalf of Willy. He hasn't been feeling well lately and needs to rest his bones, but he wrote a note on his fridge to make absolutely sure he sent you a Christmas gift. He should be back on his feet by tomorrow morning. Please accept this on his behalf.^^- An old friend of Willy's%item id (O)219 3%%[#]Letter from an old friend
ASF_WillyBelatedGiftYear100: A hundred years is a long time to put up with an old sailor like me, @. Most folks would have gotten tired of my fish stories ages ago. Thanks for always listenin', and for stickin' around all these years.^^- Willy%item id 797 10%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyRandomGift1: Been castin' your line lately, @?^^Figured ye might need a bit of a boost if you're standin' by the water all day.^^Cooked this up myself. Eat a 'Dish o' The Sea' before you cast, and you'll find the fish a bit more cooperative.^^Yoba watch over ye.^^- Willy%item id 242 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyRandomGift2: Fishing quite a bit since last fall, @?^^Figured you might be ready for something a bit more advanced.^^Try this 'Barbed Hook', it'll help keep your catch steady once it bites!^^Keep practicing, soon you'll be outfishing me!^^- Willy%item id 691 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyMarlinCatchLetter: Word travels fast around these docks, @.^^A Marlin. A real one.^^I spent three weeks chasing one off the cape when I was younger and lost every time. Came home smelling like salt and defeat.^^You made it look easy, and I'm not sure how I feel about that.^^Proud, mostly. Take this.^^- Willy%item id 797 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyMahiMahiCatchLetter: A Mahi Mahi, @?^^Those golden scales don't stay bright long once they're out of the water, but I bet yours shimmered something fierce.^^I saw my first one off a fishing vessel years back, never thought I'd see one pulled from these waters.^^Here's a little something to mark the catch.^^- Willy%item id 833 5%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyHammerheadSharkCatchLetter: I had to read your name twice, @.^^A Hammerhead Shark. You actually brought one in.^^Most folks go pale just hearing about them out past the reef. That wide head, the way they cut the water... there's nothing else like it.^^Take this. You've earned every bit of it.^^- Willy%item id 166 1%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillySpringRainFirstLetter: The smell of rain on the sea brings back memories, @.^^Keep your line ready, the critters love to stir on days like this!^^- Willy[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillySpooktopusCatchLetter: Caught a Spooktopus, @?^^Haven't seen one since a foggy night long ago... it slipped past my boat and looked right back at me with those glowing eyes.^^You should be proud, not many can reel in a creature like that.^^Here's a little gift to mark the occasion.^^- Willy%item id 856 2%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_WillyNightMarketTipsLetter: Night Market's coming soon, @!^^Best time of year for deep-sea fishing.^^If you head down to that submarine, keep your eyes peeled, strange critters lurk in the glowing dark.^^Here's a little something to help you reel them in!^^- Willy%item id 774 3%%[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_SantaChristmasLetterYear3: Ho ho ho, @!^^Season's greetings to you, my dear!^^Grandpa always said that a warm fire and a cheerful heart makes the best gift of all.^^Keep your hands busy with your work, but don't forget to watch for those who could use a sprinkle of holiday cheer.^^Leave a little treat by the hearth, and know that I'm peeking in with a merry smile!^^Here's an early Christmas gift to keep you cozy this winter.^^- Santa%item id 629 2%%[#]Letter from Santa
ASF_EvelynChristmasYear2Letter: Dear @,^^Merry Christmas, my sweet child! I was watching you from the porch lately, and I just couldn't help but smile seeing how far you've come since you first arrived in the valley.^^You have grown into such a remarkable and capable person. Your grandfather would be so proud to see what you've done with the place, and the angler you've become.^^Know that you're always welcome at our home.^^- Evelyn[#]Letter from Evelyn
ASF_PirateCaptainLetter: Ye who holds this coin...^^You've got the mark now. No mistakin' it.^^That doubloon weren't meant to be found, yet somehow it found its way to you.^^We buried more than treasure out there, far past the safe tides.^^If the waters start turnin' wrong, don't follow 'em.^^Some things taken by the sea ain't meant to be brought back.^^- Captain R. Blacktide^^[#]Salt-Worn Letter
ASF_WillyFlowerDanceYear3Letter: Flower Dance is comin' up in a couple days, @!^^You should head out and enjoy it. Good weather, good company, and the flowers are somethin' special this year.^^Back in the day, your grandpa and I would join the Flower Dance together.^^I wasn't much of a dancer, but I made my own little move... called it the Red Wiggler.^^Eh... didn't really catch on with anyone else, though.^^Guess some things are better left in the water.^^- Willy[#]Letter from Willy
ASF_LeprechaunSpringYear2Letter: Right then, I'll be havin' none o' this nonsense any longer!^^Me finest hat... GREEN as a four-leaf clover, tall as me pride has been STOLEN, by a FISH.^^I saw it meself, snatched straight off me head as I was havin' a wee rest by the shores, the cheek of it!^^If ye happen to cross paths with a fish wearin' a very distinguished hat... be careful!^^Don't ye dare laugh.^^- O'Finley[#]Crumpled Note
ASF_GiftWillyHammerheadShark: Well now! A Hammerhead Shark, is it?$h#$b#I'll get her settled in me tank proper, like. Thanks!
ASF_GiftWillyMahiMahi: Hello there! A Mahi Mahi, fresh as the sea breeze!$h#$b#Golden and lively, just like they should be.#$b#This'll brighten up me tank something fierce. Much obliged!
ASF_GiftWillyMarlin: Well now, a Marlin!$h#$b#Look at the size of this beauty, straight from the deep blue!#$b#She'll have a prime spot in me collection. Cheers to you!
ASF_GiftWillyAlaskanKingSalmon: Great Neptune's beard! An Alaskan King Salmon!$h#$b#Look at the size of this mighty fellow!#$b#He'll be the crown jewel of me tank, that's for sure. Thank you kindly!
ASF_GiftWillyBlueSpottedOctopus: A Blue-Spotted Octopus...$s#$b#Blast it all, those colors look like trouble brewing.#$b#I don't fancy having this slippery menace anywhere near me gear!
ASF_GiftWillySeaTurtle: Well now! A Sea Turtle, eh?$h#$b#Graceful as the ocean itself, she is.#$b#She'll be treated like royalty in me tank, thanks to you!
ASF_GiftWillyRedRockCrab: Well now! A Red Rock Crab!$h#$b#A feisty little critter, eh?#$b#Might just find a cozy corner for this one!
ASF_GiftWillyHermitCrab: Hello there! A Hermit Crab, bless my eyes!$h#$b#Always fun watching 'em scuttle about.#$b#Thanks, this'll make a fine addition to me collection!
ASF_GiftWillyPinkHermitCrab: Well now, a Pink Hermit Crab!$h#$b#Colors like that don't come around often.#$b#She'll brighten up any corner, that's for sure!
ASF_GiftWillyOrangeStarfish: By the tides! An Orange Starfish!$h#$b#A sight for sore eyes, eh?#$b#Might just put this one on display for a spell!
ASF_GiftWillyScallop: Great Neptune! A Scallop!$h#$b#Smooth and round, reminds me of calm days at sea.#$b#Much obliged.
ASF_GiftWillySpooktopus: A Spooktopus... great Neptune's nightmares... $s#$b#That thing gives me a cold shiver I can't shake.#$b#Why did you bring something so cursed-looking aboard...?
ASF_GiftWillyPinkJellyfish: Ah... a Pink Jellyfish.$h#$b#Never been too fond of handling these slippery glowing things.#$b#But I appreciate the thought, truly.
ASF_GiftWillyBlueJellyfish: A Blue Jellyfish, eh?$h#$b#Pretty glow, but they always give me the shivers.#$b#Still... thank you for bringing it by.
ASF_GiftWillyBrownEel: Well now, a Brown Eel!$h#$b#Rain or shine, these slippery fellows are always a sight to behold.#$b#I'll be keeping a careful eye on this one.
ASF_GiftWillyLeopardStingray: Great Neptune! A Leopard Stingray from Ginger Island!$h#$b#Spots like that belong in a gallery, not just the sea.#$b#This'll be remembered for sure.
ASF_GiftWillyRibbonEel: Ah... a Ribbon Eel, huh?$u#$b#Never been too fond of how they twist and coil like that.#$b#Still, can't deny it's an unusual catch. Thanks.
ASF_GiftWillyGreenEel: Oh... a Green Eel.$u#$b#I've spent my life at sea, but eels still give me the shivers.#$b#Reckon I'll admire this one from a distance. Appreciate it.
ASF_GiftWillyOrangeEel: Well now... an Orange Eel.$u#$b#Bright as it is, I've never trusted a fish that moves like a snake.#$b#Still, it's a fine catch. Thanks for bringing it.
ASF_GiftWillyHookfin: Well now! A Hookfin!$h#$b#Never seen one dance like that before, fins all sharp and proud.#$b#I'll be keeping a close watch on this specimen.
ASF_GiftWillyPacificJellyfish: Ah... a Pacific Jellyfish.$h#$b#Beautiful to look at, not so pleasant to keep near my hands.#$b#I'll take it off your hands anyway.
ASF_GiftWillyFlameJellyfish: A Flame Jellyfish?$h#$b#Fiery colors or not, they're a bit too stingy for my taste.#$b#But I'm grateful for the gift.
ASF_GiftWillyGardenSnail: Well now! A Garden Snail from the dock!$h#$b#Funny how they tumble down with the rain, eh?#$b#A curious little creature, thanks for giving it to me!
ASF_GiftWillyGhoulgill: Great Neptune's shadow... a Ghoulgill!$h#$b#That pale, ghostly look gives me the chills something fierce.#$b#Strangest night fish I've seen in years, thanks for the fright!
ASF_GiftWillyBroombell: Well now, a Broombell!$h#$b#Heh... looks just like one of those witchy hats from Spirit's Eve.#$b#Rare little drifter, I'll see she gets a safe spot in me tank!
ASF_GiftWillyJackOFish: Well now... a Jack O' Fish!?$h#$b#Only ever seen these once in a blue moon, fiery eyes and all.#$b#This eerie beauty'll be the star of me whole collection. Much obliged!
ASF_GiftWillySprucefin: Well now! A Sprucefin, eh?$h#$b#Shimmers like a tiny Christmas tree, ornaments and all!#$b#I'll make sure she gets a prime spot in me tank for the season.
ASF_GiftWillyJollyfin: Hello there! A Jollyfin!$h#$b#Bright reds and greens, looking like a present straight from the North Pole!#$b#She'll be the merriest little swimmer in me collection.
ASF_GiftWillyRedpuff: Well now, a Redpuff!$h#$b#Round and shiny like a proper holiday ornament, dancing through the water.#$b#Might just hang this one on me tree!
ASF_GiftWillyGingerfin: Great Neptune's beard... a Gingerfin!$h#$b#Sweet-smelling and warm-toned, like a cookie floating in the sea!#$b#This rare little fellow'll be a cozy addition to me tank!
ASF_GiftWillyPufferjelly: Well now! A Pufferjelly!$h#$b#Looks like a little pufferfish trapped inside a jelly, eh?#$b#A clever one, I'll make sure it has a proper spot in me tank.
ASF_GiftWillyAppleSnail: Well now! Look at the shell on this snail!$h#$b#Never seen one this big in the Valley before. Must've hitched a ride on the way back with you.#$b#I'll keep it well-fed with algae. Thanks, friend.
ASF_GiftWillyTreeSpiderCrab: A crab! And a fancy purple one, at that.$h#$b#Climbs trees, you say? Sounds like a real character.#$b#I'll put him in the proper tank where he can climb around. Thanks!
ASF_GiftWillyYellowtail: Well now! A Yellowtail, eh?$h#$b#Golden and lively, just like a sunbeam on the reef!#$b#She'll brighten up me tank something fierce. Much obliged!
ASF_GiftWillyMossyEel: Ugh... a Mossy Eel.$s#$b#Slimy, and stinks like low tide. Can't say I'm thrilled.#$b#Keep it away from the bait bucket.
ASF_GiftWillyHumpheadWrasse: Woah! A Humphead Wrasse...$h#$b#I've chased these since my first trip to the reefs.#$b#A beauty like this deserves a place of honor in me tank!
ASF_GiftWillyLuckyfin: Well I'll be! A Luckyfin!$h#$b#This lil' fella gave me old man quite the chase.#$b#I'll treat him right, don't ye worry!
ASF_GiftWillyWhaleShark: Yoba's teeth!$h#$b#I've only ever heard the old sailors speak of such gentle giants.#$b#This takes me breath away.
ASF_GiftWillyLemonShark: Well now! A Lemon Shark, eh?$h#$b#Funny name for a shark, but she's a beauty all the same.#$b#I'll make sure this golden fish gets a fine spot in me tank!
ASF_GiftWillySantafish: Ho ho! A Santafish!$h#$b#Look at that fluffy beard, would ye? Reminds me of Winter Star mornings.#$b#He'll bring a bit o' holiday cheer to me tank all year round!
ASF_GiftWillyBlueDolphin: A Dolphin... well, would ya look at that!$h#$b#Old sailors always said they're friends of those who make their livin' at sea.#$b#I'll make sure to release her right away!
ASF_GiftWillyRedCoral: Well now, Red Coral!$h#$b#Bright and bristling with the sun's memory.#$b#Lovely bit of ocean, thanks for the gift.
ASF_GiftWillyMermaidPearl: Great Neptune's beard... a Mermaid's Pearl!$h#$b#Shiny as moonlight, and rare as a calm sea at midnight.#$b#I'll be holding onto this with care!
ASF_GiftWillyMermaidTear: Ah... a Mermaid's Tear.$h#$b#Soft as a lullaby, and filled with odd little magic, if you ask me.#$b#I appreciate you bringing this to me.
ASF_GiftWillyLunarPearl: Great Neptune... a Lunar Pearl!$h#$b#They say it absorbs the moonlight across the waves.#$b#This is a truly rare treasure, thank you!
ASF_GiftWillyAncientShell: Well now, an Ancient Shell!$h#$b#Feels like it holds a thousand tides in it.#$b#I'll give it a fine spot where folks can wonder at it.
ASF_GiftWillyPiratesDoubloon: Hello there! A Pirate's Doubloon, is it?$h#$b#Gold like that makes an old sea dog smile.#$b#Thanks, might keep it as a token of a good catch!
ASF_GiftWillyRubberDuck: A Rubber Duck?! Ha!$l#$b#Now that's a catch I haven't seen in a while!$l#$b#Ye know, this actually reminds me of the one my father used to keep on his ship.$h#$b#Thank ye kindly, @.
ASF_WillyFishCaught_MahiMahi: Ah, you caught the Mahi Mahi, did ya?$h#$b#That one's a lively little fish, good work.$h
ASF_WillyFishCaught_Marlin: By Neptune's beard... you finally got the Marlin!$h#$b#That one tests even the best anglers.
ASF_WillyFishCaught_SeaTurtle: Ah, a Sea Turtle, did ya?$h#$b#Graceful and steady, a fine catch.$h
ASF_WillyFishCaught_JackOFish: Well now... you caught the Jack O' Fish!$h#$b#Not many have seen one of these, good on you.
ASF_WillyFishCaught_Gingerfin: Ah, you caught a Gingerfin, did ya?$h#$b#A common enough catch, but a nice one nonetheless.$h
ASF_WillyFishCaught_MossyEel: ...Mossy Eel? It smells like a swamp.$s#$b#Not the kind of catch I'd brag about, but you got it out of the water, I suppose.
ASF_WillyFishCaught_HumpheadWrasse: I've been dreamin' of catching one of those Humphead Wrasses since I was a young deckhand.$h#$b#That is a truly extraordinary catch!
ASF_WillyFishCaught_Spooktopus: Dear me, a Spooktopus!?$s#$b#I'll be honest with ya, that thing gives me the shivers somethin' fierce.#$b#But you caught it, and that takes real nerve.
ASF_WillyFishCaught_HammerheadShark: Well now, a Hammerhead Shark?$u#$b#That's one for the record books, truly.
ASF_WillyFishCaught_BlueSpottedOctopus: Hm... a Blue-Spotted Octopus.$u#$b#Beautiful creature, I'll admit that much.#$b#Just keep those bright rings away from my tackle, if ya don't mind.
ASF_WillyFishCaught_Luckyfin: Aye, ye hooked a Luckyfin, eh?#$b#Those little scamps are trickier to land than they look!$h
